name: Judges
tagline: A cycle of sin, rescue, and decline
author: Not named in the text. Jewish tradition names Samuel.
date: Covers the period between Joshua and the monarchy, roughly 1200 to 1050 BC.
setting: Israel in the land without a king, surrounded by other peoples.
theme: Israel repeatedly turns from God, and God repeatedly raises up deliverers, yet the people grow worse and a king is needed.

outline.label: Why the land was not fully taken
Micah’s idol and the tribe of Dan

christInBook: Each judge is a flawed rescuer, and the book keeps asking for a king who will be better. The true Judge and Deliverer is Jesus, who rescues once for all and reigns forever.
howToRead: Read the book as a downward spiral: sin, oppression, cry for help, deliverance, and then relapse. The refrain “In those days there was no king in Israel” signals what the book is asking.
